stories.title: Jarry continues strong goaltending for Oilers
stories.summary: Don't look now, but the Edmonton Oilers suddenly have good goaltending to go along with their potent offensive attack.

stories.title: Bouchard nets OT winner, Oilers top Flyers 3-2
stories.summary: Evan Bouchard scored the game-winning goal 47 seconds into overtime as the Edmonton Oilers won their third game in a row, getting past the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Wednesday.

stories.title: Zibanejad scores twice, Rangers beat Flames 3-1
stories.summary: Mika Zibanejad scored twice in the second period on Wednesday to lead the New York Rangers to a 3-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Mark Kilam ‘where I’m supposed to be’ as Edmonton Elks head coach
stories.summary: Mark Kilam admits he's sentimental about his first Grey Cup as a head coach in a city he called home for 20 years — but it pales compared to his pride over Edmonton's resurgence.

stories.title: Canada says Russian players with visas will still be barred from World Juniors
stories.summary: The statement appears to close the door on Russia's return to the world juniors after last month's court ruling that the IIHF must reinstate the country in international hockey.

stories.title: Balmy November across Alberta triggers wildfire advisories and warnings
stories.summary: Above-average temperatures with little rain or snow and has elevated the wildfire risk across parts of Alberta this November, and a Super El Niño may lead to a mild winter too.

stories.title: Wainwright honours soldiers killed, injured in fire: ‘Tragedy befell this small town’
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered at the Wainwright arena for a Remembrance Day ceremony that hit closer to home for the central Alberta military community, still shaken from last month's tragedy.

stories.title: Family of CFB Wainwright burn victim honour him at Remembrance Day in St. Albert
stories.summary: The wife and mom of Liam Ramage attended Remembrance Day on behalf of the soldier who has burns across 40 per cent of his body and is hospitalized in the University of Alberta ICU.

stories.title: Future of 66-year-old McMahon Stadium in the spotlight ahead of Grey Cup
stories.summary: The 66-year-old building will host the Canadian Football League's championship game Sunday between the Edmonton Elks and Montreal Alouettes.

stories.title: Remembrance Day ceremony honours CFB Wainwright fire victims
stories.summary: Four soldiers killed in a fire during a training exercise at CFB Wainwright were honoured at a community Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday.
